subject: ent
title: Papillomatosis, Laryngeal Tuberculosis and Keratosis

steps.tx: **HPV types six and eleven** cause recurrent respiratory papillomatosis, the wart like laryngeal growths that recur after removal in children infected at delivery and in adults by mucosal contact. Type eleven runs more aggressively than type six in most series. Lesions favour the fold free edge and anterior commissure, hoarsening voice before obstructing the airway in neglected disease.
steps.say: Low risk viral types produce recurrent wart growths on the folds. The eleven type is more aggressive than the six type usually. Hoarseness precedes obstruction in neglected disease progression.

vis.alt: Vocal fold diagram showing free edge sites favoured by papilloma growth.
vis.caption: Fold sites favoured by papilloma. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Juvenile disease presents before age five with progressive hoarseness, weak cry and stridor, needing repeated debulking that scars folds permanently if aggressive. Adult disease is often solitary and slower, with malignant change described rarely in long standing cases. **Tracheostomy** is avoided where possible because distal tracheal seeding follows, converting laryngeal disease into tracheobronchial disease that is far harder to clear.
steps.say: Early childhood disease needs repeated debulking with permanent scarring risk. Tracheostomy is avoided because distal seeding worsens clearance difficulty. Adult disease is slower and often solitary.

vis.title: Papillomatosis by age group
rows: Avoid tracheostomy, HPV types six and eleven

steps.tx: Adjuvant therapy enters when surgery frequency exceeds roughly four procedures yearly, lesions spread distally or airway threatens between operations. Intralesional antiviral injection, systemic agents and vaccination strategies are layered in specialist centres. **Vaccination** against the causative types prevents incident disease at population level, which is the long term exit from this surgical treadmill for future cohorts.
steps.say: Frequent surgery or distal spread needs adjuvant therapy in specialist centres. Vaccination prevents incident disease and gives population level exit. Procedure frequency guides adjuvant timing decisions.

steps.tx: **Laryngeal tuberculosis** classically affects the posterior larynx, interarytenoid region and arytenoids in patients with cavitary pulmonary disease, producing painful hoarseness, odynophonia and shallow ulcers with pale granulations. Pain out of proportion to appearance separates it from cancer, its great mimic. Antituberculous therapy heals larynx with lung, while biopsy excludes carcinoma when ulceration looks malignant.
steps.say: Posterior laryngeal disease with painful hoarseness indicates tuberculosis with lung cavitation. Pain beyond appearance separates infection from cancer mimicry. Antituberculous therapy heals both sites together.

steps.tx: **Laryngeal keratosis** is white patch disease of the folds, leukoplakia of the larynx, whose dysplasia grade on biopsy decides observation, stripping or cancer surveillance intensity. Smoking drives most cases and cessation is treatment, not advice decoration. Any keratosis with erythroplasia, ulceration or mobility change escalates to cancer exclusion urgently, mirroring oral cavity rules in the previous module.
steps.say: White fold patches need biopsy grading for surveillance intensity decisions. Smoking cessation provides treatment backbone in keratosis care. Red change or ulceration needs urgent cancer exclusion.

vis.alt: Glottic region diagram for orientation to keratosis and early cancer of the fold.
vis.caption: Glottic orientation for keratosis assessment. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Puberphonia** and functional disorders from the previous lesson contrast here with structural infection and premalignancy: functional voices have normal white light anatomy, while keratosis and tuberculosis declare visible lesions. The endoscopy report therefore triages therapy first versus biopsy first pathways. Persistent hoarseness beyond three weeks in a smoker bypasses functional labels entirely and earns biopsy pathway assessment.
steps.say: Functional voices have normal anatomy while infections declare visible lesions. Endoscopy separates therapy first from biopsy first pathways clearly. Smoker hoarseness beyond three weeks needs biopsy assessment.

steps.tx: Voice outcomes in papillomatosis balance airway clearance against fold scarring, so debulking preserves anterior commissure and layered structure wherever disease allows. Staged procedures beat heroic clearance that webs the commissure permanently. **Anterior commissure webs** after aggressive surgery hoarsen more than the papillomas did, a trade patients must consent before repeated operations begin.
steps.say: Clearance balances airway against scarring in repeated papilloma surgery. Staged procedures prevent commissure webs that worsen voice permanently. Consent includes scarring trade before repeated operations.

steps.tx: Tuberculosis of the larynx is infectious to endoscopy staff through aerosolised secretions, so airway procedures use respiratory precautions until therapy renders the patient non infectious. Healing may leave posterior scarring and arytenoid fixation that hoarsens permanently despite microbiological cure. **Voice review** after therapy therefore separates active disease surveillance from scar rehabilitation, two different clinics with different interventions.
steps.say: Airway procedures need respiratory precautions until therapy removes infectiousness. Posterior scarring hoarsens voice despite microbiological cure in some patients. Surveillance and rehabilitation are separate follow up tasks.

steps.tx: Keratosis surveillance intervals follow dysplasia: mild change observes with cessation support, severe dysplasia or carcinoma in situ receives excision and close endoscopic review. Photograph documentation at each visit detects interval change better than memory. **Field cancerisation** of the whole upper airway in smokers means oral, pharyngeal and lung review accompany laryngeal surveillance at least annually.
steps.say: Dysplasia grade sets surveillance intervals and excision thresholds in keratosis. Photographs give interval change detection better than memory at visits. Whole airway review is part of laryngeal surveillance in smokers.

steps.tx: Module synthesis separates three white or wart fold lesions by cause. Papilloma is viral and recurrent, keratosis is smoking related and premalignant, tuberculosis is infectious and posterior. Each has a non surgical backbone: vaccination and adjuvants, cessation and grading, antituberculous therapy. **Biopsy judgement** differs: papilloma spares tissue, keratosis grades tissue, tuberculosis samples tissue while excluding cancer.
steps.say: Viral recurrence, smoking premalignancy and posterior infection separate three fold lesions. Non surgical backbones dominate long term control in each disease. Biopsy strategy differs by tissue need per lesion.

vis.title: Three fold lesions separated
rows: HPV types six and eleven, adjuvants and vaccine

cards.b: HPV 6 and 11 (11 more aggressive); avoid tracheostomy to prevent distal seeding, add adjuvants if surgery is frequent.
Posterior larynx and arytenoids with cavitary lung disease; painful ulcers mimic cancer.
Biopsy grade decides care; stop smoking, excise severe dysplasia, survey the whole airway.

keys: Painful posterior ulcers suggest tuberculosis over cancer
